notes: Parts 31-35 (50 groups) processed; each group was a distinct round or non-funding item, so no groups were merged and no round-up articles needed expanding (the OuterSignal Business Journals '7 more NYC deals' round-up had no text and was used only as a second source for OuterSignal). 25 web lookups (all WebSearch, no fetches) were used, highest amounts first, to fill HQ, round type or identity for: Kapta Space (Seattle), Brellium (NYC, stage undisclosed), Confido Health (US-based; the new money is a $12.5M Series A extension, recorded as amount_usd with the $22.5M Series A total in the description), Arctic Therapeutics (Iceland; leads Pekron/Sanos/Kaldbakur/Landvaettir are not in the article text so investors left empty), Tamr (growth equity led by Volition Capital, not in text), Inc.com 'This Startup' = Longeye (SF, $20M Series A led by N47 with a16z, not in text), Polyphron (NY seed led by Quiet Capital, announced 2026-09-17, not in text), Zippy (no AI claim), Undecimal Bio (sources split Tel Aviv vs Cambridge UK; recorded IL), Sharp Performance (Carlsbad CA, no AI claim), Sunlight AI (New York/Miami; Axios reports $10M of the $17.4M is new), Avarra (San Mateo), Novele (Stamford CT, announced 2026-09-30), Epyr (Paris, EUR 15M Series A led by SlateVC, not in text), Helicon (LA composites, $16.5M seed led by AlleyCorp, not in text), Daptic (NYC), Ampersand (SF), Sante (NYC), Sunbound (sources give Washington DC and Cleveland; recorded Washington DC), Basalt Health (Nashville, announced 2026-09-24), GenHealth.ai (Boston, announced 2026-09-08), Trebellar (SF, announced 2026-09-24), Restate (Berlin), Hephaestus (London; Business Wire frames $17.2M as funding to date), Vocca (sources split; the most detailed says New York HQ with most of the team in Paris, so US under the dual-HQ rule). Investor names found only via lookups were not added because the contract requires a verbatim span in the article text. Judgment calls: FORT Robotics $20M is ~$10M new financing plus a $10M PIPE commitment tied to its SPAC merger (kept in scope, confidence 0.6); Atombeam is a Regulation A+ raise (round_type Other); LanzaJet's $20M came from its parent company (round_type Other); Helical Fusion JPY 3.23B uses the article's own $20.6M conversion; Axya CAD 17M converted at 0.72; NVM Ventures and Masia fund closes converted at EUR 1.16. AblePay Health and Switched Source were set is_ai_ml=false from article text without a lookup because the budget was exhausted. The Delaware human-AI healthcare hub (Inquirer, no text) was marked not-funding at confidence 0.55 without a lookup.
